content.text: For [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-only-real|Why Payment]]-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-honest-side-2|COREMERCH guide to solutions]]-west-africa-trap-most|digital]] creators in restricted countries, the issue isn't necessarily what products to sell or how to market them – it's how to overcome the platform restrictions imposed by Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Payhip, and others. Take Nigeria, for instance, where Stripe operates, but users still face difficulties due to PayPal restrictions. Similar challenges exist in countries like Ghana, Pakistan, and Zimbabwe, where digital sellers are locked out of conventional payment gateways. This comparison highlights the infrastructure alternatives available to creators in these restricted countries.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Stripe operates in 46 countries worldwide, but its lack of support in several regions, including Nigeria and Ghana, leaves digital creators vulnerable. PayPal's account suspension policy can hold funds for up to 180 days, leaving sellers uncertain about their income. Gumroad and Payhip offer alternatives, but their own restrictions and limitations make them less than ideal. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH provides a solid foundation for digital sellers, with a comprehensive suite of tools and services that don't rely on Stripe or PayPal.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Payhip generally do not support restricted countries, while PayPal's account suspension policy can cause significant issues. Stripe's limited support in some regions means that digital creators may face difficulties in accessing payments. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed to work in restricted countries, providing a reliable and secure way for digital sellers to operate. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, the Edge Commerce Stack offers a robust infrastructure that can withstand platform restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal's fees can range from 2.9% + $0.30 to 3.4% + $0.30, depending on the country and payment method. Gumroad and Payhip charge similar fees, but with limitations on the types of payments they can process. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a flat fee of 0.5% with no hidden charges or limitations. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH includes NOWPayments integration, ensuring that digital sellers can access fast and secure payments without worrying about excessive fees.
The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH provides a robust infrastructure for digital sellers in restricted countries.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Stripe and PayPal, digital sellers often lose control over their infrastructure, as these platforms dictate the terms of service and payment processing. Gumroad and Payhip offer more control, but their limitations can still cause issues. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH empowers digital sellers to own their infrastructure, automate payment processing, and deliver products securely. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages and Workers, sellers can configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings for enhanced security and email deliverability.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When deciding which infrastructure to use, consider the level of control and flexibility you need. If you require a robust and secure foundation for your digital business, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH is an excellent choice. With its comprehensive suite of tools and services, you can overcome platform restrictions and focus on growing your business. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about the Edge Commerce Stack and other infrastructure solutions.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes NOWPayments integration, ensuring fast and secure payments without excessive fees.

By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, you can overcome platform restrictions and focus on growing your business. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about the Edge Commerce Stack and other infrastructure solutions.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.

Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH is designed to work with your existing Gumroad or Payhip account. However, you may need to migrate your products and settings to the new infrastructure.

COREMERCH offers 30-day support for the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), including documentation, support resources, and assistance from their team. If you encounter any issues, refer to the documentation and reach out to their team for help.
Can I deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) in a restricted country?

Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH is designed to work in restricted countries, providing a reliable and secure way for digital sellers to operate. However, you may need to consider local regulations and payment processing requirements.
How do I migrate my products and settings to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197)?

To migrate your products and settings to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), follow these steps: create a GitHub account and set up a new repository; configure Cloudflare Pages and Workers; integrate Supabase and NOWPayments; load your products and configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings.
